title: CC-RC1.4 Certified Basis & Compositional Closure
summary: Refine CC8 OTCC with operation-specific multi-epoch causal basis witnesses, transitive/dispatch-conservative effect closure, canonical resource identity and projection receipts. Runtime observation may narrow a trusted static closure but not silently expand it. High-stakes freshness/authority decisions are deterministically compiled before small-model consumption.
hard_rules: activation is not truth or GWT ignition
state_root remains snapshot identity but not universal validity predicate
cross-branch agreement with shared ancestry is not replication
open_questions: Can real FRANK operations be analyzed with complete enough closure across Python callbacks/DB/tool/plugin boundaries?
Which basis dimensions need exact equality versus causal/lineage compatibility?
What canonical resource identity should span DB rows, files, tool capabilities, URLs and external accounts?
Does a pinned Qwen3-4B gain accuracy/tokens from compiled projections without losing useful reasoning flexibility?
Can a Clay-written compiler reproduce closure semantics independently of K0?
domains_note: Aus dem ersten Segment der Paketkennung abgeleitet; der Wert kommt im Bestand bereits vor und ist ein registrierter Trigger. Nicht inhaltlich bestimmt.
